
# Correlation Kendall-Tau {#sec-kendall}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}
$$
    \tau = \frac{C - D}{\frac{1}{2}n(n-1)}
$${#eq-kendall}

$C$ = number of concordant pairs
$D$ = number of discordant pairs
$n$ = number of observations
